supersedes: docs/evidence/native-ct2-fixed-arena-2026-10-28.json (d41f7d5717a3, borrowed the C start's call into main)
console_basis: docs/evidence/native-ct2-fixed-arena-console-2026-10-28.json: d41f7d5717a3 reached the lease (payload 0x0cf00020) and refused at the SDK SCI route because the SDK vector was not yet installed

borrowed_call.caller: 0x8c01aa64 (game init, called once from main's body at 0x8c01b082)

plan.order: The trampoline retires the literal to the low heap hook, makes the borrowed call with the caller's R4-R7, keeps its R0/R1, calls the low heap hook with the arena, then returns to 0x8c01aa90. The hook therefore runs where SDK titles call their allocator initializer: after the hardware init has copied the SDK vector (0x8c166218) to VBR 0x8c00f400 and defaulted the callback table.
static_checks: the literal has one PC-relative reader and no aligned word holds its address; no other word names the hardware init
no patch window (driver submit, initializer, release, the three terminal exits, BIOS literal) touches the borrowed call or its literal
the child-pool budget proof finds no pool shape after the borrowed call and returns NONE without a read
the hardware init takes no stack arguments

CT2's SDK SCI family (vector 0x8c166218, table initializer 0x8c15c14a) is the reviewed full-FPU family; later handler registrations name chain events 0x900 and 0xa60 only, so nothing after the hardware init writes the SCI slots at VBR+0x25c/0x260
plan.stack: The game init's frame and the trampoline's three words put the low heap hook entry about 128 bytes below the boot stack top, inside its owner-stack window [0x0c008100, 0x0c00f400].

limits: RAM maps bound the writes of two sessions, not every path through the game.
The SDK SCI route admission itself runs only on the console; its live checks decide.
Console save, load and play are untested.
